name: The Peninsula Beverly Hills
insider_take: Old Hollywood glamour meets modern luxury in the heart of Beverly Hills, where A-listers have been making power deals over afternoon tea since 1991.
whats_special: This iconic property sits on the only corner in Beverly Hills where you can walk to Rodeo Drive, the Beverly Hills Hotel's Polo Lounge, and Greystone Mansion. The hotel's fleet of Rolls-Royce vehicles has become legendary among celebrities, and the rooftop garden supplies fresh herbs to the award-winning restaurant downstairs.
pro_tip: Book the Peninsula Academy cooking class with the executive chef - you'll learn to prepare dishes using herbs from their rooftop garden, and it's one of the few hands-on culinary experiences available at a five-star Beverly Hills property.
dont_miss: The hotel's legendary afternoon tea service, which has hosted countless Hollywood deals since the '90s. Time it right and you might spot celebrities conducting business over scones. Also, the spa's ESPA treatments using products infused with 24-karat gold - a Beverly Hills exclusive.
pros: Prime Beverly Hills location near Rodeo Drive and luxury shopping
Legendary white-glove service and personalized attention
Award-winning rooftop spa with panoramic city views
Elegant rooms and suites with sophisticated European-inspired design
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit casual travelers
